channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Marcus Smart | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Marcus Smart from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Marcus Smart, Jaylen Brown
item.description:
He asked how Stevens, who is the Celtics’ president of basketball operations, can trust his instincts when making unpopular decisions.

“Well, obviously, I’m sure a lot of people immediately got to Jaylen Brown, right, or immediately go to [Marcus Smart] a couple years ago, and that’s a really hard part of the job,”

Brad Stevens on Marcus Smart, Jaylen Brown, Aug 29, 2026. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: LeBron James on Marcus Smart, Deandre Ayton, Luke Kennard, Jake LaRavia
item.description:
“Because this is a new group. We added [Deandre Ayton], Marcus [Smart] and Jake [LaRavia] and we just got a new acquisition on our ballclub a couple games ago [in Luke Kennard]. So, it's too hard to really say what we're capable of.”

LeBron James on Marcus Smart, Deandre Ayton, Luke Kennard, Jake LaRavia, Feb 15, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Marcus Smart
item.description:
“Adding a player like Marcus Smart to our roster allows us to compete at the highest level,”

Rob Pelinka on Marcus Smart, Jul 27, 2025. Source: Lakers Nation.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Marcus Smart
item.description:
Pelinka said in a statement.

“Marcus epitomizes what it means to prioritize winning above all else – whether that’s making huge plays on the defensive end or hitting critical shots in key moments of the most intense games. He knows and understands playoff winning and will be a key leadership voice in our group. Surrounding our stars with two-way players like Marcus is critical to our overall vision of how we want to play and win next season. This is an exciting player acquisition, for sure.”

Rob Pelinka on Marcus Smart, Jul 27, 2025. Source: Lakers Nation.

item.title: Jordan Poole on Marcus Smart
item.description:
Jordan Poole on the Wizards adding Marcus Smart:

“He has the utmost respect being a Defensive Player of the Year. I've had my fair share of Marcus guarding me on the other side... his energy, his toughness, his winning mentality; I think that's something we can all vibe off of.”

Jordan Poole on Marcus Smart, Feb 8, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Bam Adebayo on Rudy Gobert, Marcus Smart, Jaren Jackson Jr
item.description:
“A point guard (Marcus Smart) got it over me, a center (Rudy Gobert) got it over me, a power forward (Jaren Jackson Jr.) has gotten it over me,”

Bam Adebayo on Rudy Gobert, Marcus Smart, Jaren Jackson Jr, Jul 10, 2024. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Draymond Green on Stephen Curry, Marcus Smart, Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
“Marcus Smart, you won DPOY, you guard Steph [Curry], right?… There’s a center who won [it] and we're asking Karl-Anthony Towns to go guard the center.”

Draymond Green on Stephen Curry, Marcus Smart, Karl-Anthony Towns, May 17, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Al Horford on Isaiah Thomas, Marcus Smart
item.description:
Al Horford:

“My time with Marcus here was very special. One of the reasons why I came here initially in ‘16 was Isaiah Thomas and Marcus. I have a lot of respect for Marcus. … Just a very special person and somebody I really appreciated.”

Al Horford on Isaiah Thomas, Marcus Smart, Feb 4, 2024. Source: Twitter @SouichiTerada.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Marcus Smart
item.description:
Jayson Tatum on Marcus Smart:

“It was an incredible moment. What he meant to the team, what he meant to the organization, what he meant to the city. He was loved. Obviously a fan favorite. ... It was much-deserved. That was a cool moment to see him get his flowers.”

Jayson Tatum on Marcus Smart, Feb 4, 2024. Source: Twitter @SouichiTerada.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Marcus Smart
item.description:
John Karalis:Jaylen Brown on Marcus Smart:

“I couldn't stand Marcus at first... and I love him now...you grow and mature as young men and you learn things about people ... But me and Marcus, we didnt start off great. I wasn't the biggest fan of Marcus when I first got to Boston.”

Jaylen Brown on Marcus Smart, Nov 19, 2023. Source: Twitter @John_Karalis.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum, Marcus Smart
item.description:
Stevens on WEEI on losing Smart:

“That gives other people a voice to step into and step up to and very obviously, we need Jayson and Jaylen to continue to grow in that area...any time you have somebody that's had such a big role and has such a big personality...we'll miss him”

Brad Stevens on Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum, Marcus Smart, Aug 30, 2023. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Marcus Smart
item.description:
Jaylen:

“One of my best friends is gone in Marcus. We've been through a lot. We've fought. We've put each other in headlocks. Boston will feel his impact that he's no longer here. But we'll move forward.”

Jaylen Brown on Marcus Smart, Jul 26, 2023. Source: Twitter @GwashburnGlobe.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Marcus Smart
item.description:
Jaylen Brown:

“With Marcus gone, we don’t want our defensive identity to go out the door as well.”

Jaylen Brown on Marcus Smart, Jul 26, 2023. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Zach Kleiman on Marcus Smart
item.description:
Damichael Cole:Zach Kleiman:

“Marcus is someone who is just a flat-out winner.… This is the type of person that we believe is going to elevate the group and help us get to where we want to, which is winning the championship.”

Zach Kleiman on Marcus Smart, Jul 7, 2023. Source: Twitter @DamichaelC.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Marcus Smart
item.description:
Jay King:Joe Mazzulla on Marcus Smart:

“You’re never going to replace a guy like him and everything he’s done on the court,what he’s done for his teammates and what he’s done in the community, for the city of Boston, you’re just not going to replace that, so it’s not worth even thinking about that”

Joe Mazzulla on Marcus Smart, Jun 29, 2023. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Grant Williams on Marcus Smart
item.description:
Gary Washburn:Grant Williams on the Smart trade:

“Something that definitely hurts a little bit. Just because you’ve been with someone so long and he’s a phenomenal person. He has as much heart and passion of anyone across this entire organization. We trust Brad and we have to not really hold too much against (the trade) because we know Marcus is going to be great wherever he goes. He’s in a great situation and a talented team and they need him. (Boston) is going to have to step up in his absence.”

Grant Williams on Marcus Smart, Jun 27, 2023. Source: Twitter @GwashburnGlobe.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Marcus Smart
item.description:
“As heart wrenching as it was to part with Marcus, it was something we felt like we had to do,”

Brad Stevens on Marcus Smart, Jun 23, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Grant Williams on Marcus Smart
item.description:
Grant Williams told The Athletic.

“Sohe’s leading that and also Smart and all our guys really are, so we’ve got to feed off their energy. He’s been really crucial for us coming back in this series.”

Grant Williams on Marcus Smart, May 26, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Kevin Love on Al Horford, Marcus Smart, Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum
item.description:
Turning to the present, Love said of the Celts,

“This is a very good team, a very good culture. I mean, we really respect the hell out of them. They’ve really got something special over there, a deep team, very well balanced, guys that were on All-Defense.“Al Horford, who’s had an unbelievable career, just holds it down at the power forward/center position. Marcus Smart won Defensive Player of the Year last year. You’ve got two superstar guys in (Jayson) Tatum and (Jaylen) Brown. I mean, just really the entire lineup.”

Kevin Love on Al Horford, Marcus Smart, Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum, May 19, 2023. Source: Heavy.com.

item.title: Malcolm Brogdon on Marcus Smart
item.description:
Chris Forsberg:Malcolm Brogdon on Marcus Smart:

“He’s a vet guy, a fringe All-Star in this league. He's been leading this team for years, led them to the Finals last year. So he's ready for these situations. He made big shots tonight. He's the point guard we need.”

Malcolm Brogdon on Marcus Smart, May 12, 2023. Source: Twitter @ChrisForsberg_.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Marcus Smart, Grant Williams
item.description:
Joe Mazzulla on Grant Williams:

“He’s in the Smart category where when he’s on the floor, we’re able to just be really dynamic defensively because of his versatility, his communication, his toughness and his ability to guard different matchups.”

Joe Mazzulla on Marcus Smart, Grant Williams, May 6, 2023. Source: Twitter @SouichiTerada.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Marcus Smart, Grant Williams
item.description:
Quin Snyder said BOS is unique:

“When you move to the defensive end, they are equally unique. They've got Williams, they've got rim protection, they have the ability to switch. They've got Marcus Smart, who to me is an elite player and possibly the best leader in the NBA.”

Quin Snyder on Marcus Smart, Grant Williams, Apr 13, 2023. Source: Twitter @KLChouinard.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Marcus Smart
item.description:
Chris Forsberg:Joe Mazzulla on Marcus Smart:

“He's good. He's ramped up. He was great today in practice, went live, he said he felt good, so he'll be ready to go.”

Joe Mazzulla on Marcus Smart, Apr 11, 2023. Source: Twitter @ChrisForsberg_.

item.title: Malcolm Brogdon on Marcus Smart
item.description:
Jay King:Malcolm Brogdon on Marcus Smart:

“He’s the leader and the type of point guard you want for a team like this.”

Malcolm Brogdon on Marcus Smart, Oct 12, 2022. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Ime Udoka on Marcus Smart
item.description:
The Celtics have the luxury of playing Smart on Green because they aren’t forced to hide a weaker defender.

“The bottom line is we put Marcus on bigs throughout the season to switch onto their guards at times,”

Ime Udoka on Marcus Smart, Jun 5, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Draymond Green on Marcus Smart
item.description:
Mark Murphy:Draymond Green on Marcus Smart:

“I think he really thinks the game. You can see it the way he plays, the way he's teaching guys, the way he's commanding attention in huddles and going through the X's and O's in the huddles. You see it all. I think he does a great job of that.”

Draymond Green on Marcus Smart, Jun 1, 2022. Source: Twitter @Murf56.

item.title: Ime Udoka on Marcus Smart
item.description:
Ime Udoka:

“Having Marcus and Al might have helped, because they settle us down, but it wasn't really just that. And it wasn't our young guys, Payton and Aaron, but it was our veterans Jayson and Jaylen who let it get away from us.”

Ime Udoka on Marcus Smart, May 18, 2022. Source: Twitter @KeithSmithNBA.

item.title: Ime Udoka on Marcus Smart
item.description:
Ime Udoka on Marcus Smart's Game 3 status with quad contusion injury:

“We'll know more tomorrow based on how he feels today, but he obviously feels better today than walking around yesterday when he couldn't go.”

Ime Udoka on Marcus Smart, May 5, 2022. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Draymond Green on Marcus Smart
item.description:
Mark Medina:Draymond Green on the DPOY award:

“I'm extremely happy for Marcus Smart. That's a guy I respect as a defender. Well deserved.”

Draymond Green on Marcus Smart, Apr 19, 2022. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Marcus Smart
item.description:
John Karalis:Jaylen on Smart DPOY:

“Marcus just cemented his name as one of the defensive greats. ... I think that’s pretty exciting. So we couldn’t be more proud of him. We got to celebrate him yesterday at practice. I ain’t seen him smile like that in a while, so that was pretty nice.”

Jaylen Brown on Marcus Smart, Apr 19, 2022. Source: Twitter @John_Karalis.
